calls.title: Voyage Prive<>GrowthBook - Event Forwarder Discussion
calls.summary: During the call, Lucas Wolff and Kamal Ahmed (Voyage Prive) spoke with Jake Heier (GrowthBook sales) and Jeremy Dorn (GrowthBook co-founder) about using GrowthBook’s event forwarder to send experiment assignment logs to BigQuery, but Jeremy advised sticking with their existing Snowplow pipeline due to lower latency and similar data quality. The team is also comparing GrowthBook with Statsig, focusing on pricing and features. Next steps: Jake will send a detailed pricing breakdown for 15 users, and a roadmap walkthrough may be scheduled to support their evaluation.
